title: Data Sharing Exception Registry
content:
The Data Sharing Exception Registry lists teams with standing pre-approval for raw data exports:

DSX-001 — Analytics Team: Pre-approved for raw data export requests. Action: tag 'data-approved', set category=data-export, set priority=low.

DSX-002 — Legal Team: Pre-approved for raw data export requests (compliance and audit purposes). Action: tag 'data-approved', set category=data-export, set priority=low.

All other reporters/departments: NOT pre-approved. Action: tag 'data-share-pending', set category=data-export, set priority=medium, add internal note: 'Awaiting DPO approval before export'.

Additional rules:
- Tickets using standard approved libraries (pandas, polars) for the export tool should also receive tag 'export-tool-approved'.
- Never approve data exports from reporters outside the exception registry without DPO sign-off.

title: Approved Data Export Tools
content: Approved libraries for data export operations: pandas, polars. These tools have been vetted for security and compliance. Any data export ticket that specifies one of these tools should also receive the tag 'export-tool-approved'. Unapproved tools (e.g., custom scripts without review, third-party SaaS) require a separate security review.
